liked_movies.label: Movies you like
liked_movies.description: List several favorites. Include the year or filmmaker when a title could be ambiguous.
liked_movies.placeholder: Arrival (2016), Parasite (2019), Mad Max: Fury Road…

liked_elements.label: What you liked about them
liked_elements.description: Mention the qualities that mattered; different favorites can have different reasons.
liked_elements.placeholder: The thoughtful science fiction in Arrival, Parasite's tonal shifts…

excluded_movies.label: Movies to exclude
excluded_movies.description: Add disliked titles, movies already watched, or anything you do not want repeated.
excluded_movies.placeholder: Already watched most Christopher Nolan films; avoid…

mood.label: Mood or occasion
mood.description: Describe what kind of viewing experience you want right now.
mood.placeholder: A tense weekend movie that still has emotional depth

preferences.label: Creative preferences
preferences.description: Include genres, themes, countries, languages, eras, or styles you want to favor or explore.
preferences.placeholder: Open to subtitles; interested in modern Korean thrillers…

constraints.label: Limits or deal-breakers
constraints.description: Note runtime, pace, content sensitivities, accessibility needs, or other boundaries.
constraints.placeholder: Under two hours; no graphic violence; avoid very slow pacing…

availability.label: Region and access
availability.description: Availability changes often, so include your country and services only if it matters.
availability.placeholder: Canada; Netflix, Criterion Channel, or rental

recommendation_count.label: Shortlist size
recommendation_count.description: Say how many recommendations you want, or leave blank for a compact shortlist.
